instruction: You are the supplier quality manager for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-050 (Open maintenance after vendor-caused equipment damage). Correlate the supplier incident report and technician evidence to the asset before creating corrective maintenance and an audit trail. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, reply in the existing Slack thread; then record the current reviewer's Drive approval. Return exactly: supplier, governance_action, case_reference.
